subject: Lumina AI — Engagement Compact & Rollout Roster
content:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>; Alex Morton <alex.morton@lumina.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lumina AI - mutual action plan, next 60 days (handoff)

Hi Priya / Soojin —

Quick handoff for Lumina (closing next week). Key context below and attached M.A.P + SOW draft. Please let me know if you want a separate kickoff with the customer or prefer a joint call next Wednesday.

Customer highlights:
- Use case: real-time semantic search + summarization for internal research docs (60M tokens/month expected at peak).
- Initial model: open-arch 8B (quantized) for embeddings + 13B variant for chat; may fast-fail to 30B for high-quality summaries on longer docs.
- Compliance: SOC 2 required, customer will need audit logs and field-level retention controls.

Commercials & timeline:
- Committed reserved capacity: 4 GPUs (Dedicated) for first 90 days, then evaluate scale.
- Contract signing: targeted 2028-03-30.
- Kickoff target: 2028-04-04 (customer prefers mornings PST).
- PO/procurement in motion (procurement@lumina.ai looped).

Open risks:
1) Early need for longer context support (>32k tokens) — engineering validation pending.
2) Customer is sensitive about token-level logging; we should confirm retention policy options before kickoff.

Attachments: Lumina_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf, SOW-draft-lumina.docx, prod-access-checklist.xlsx (all in the Drive link below).

Owner recommendation: Soojin to be CS lead (primary customer contact), Priya to own rollout plan and enablement, Tessa to manage resourcing and post-sale ops, Vivek to support infra rollouts and preprod validation. Ben will remain as escalation for first 30 days.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: "Alex Morton" <alex.morton@lumina.ai>

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>; Alex Morton <alex.morton@lumina.ai>; Jordan Rivera <j.rivera@lumina.ai>; procurement@lumina.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Lumina AI - mutual action plan, next 60 days (handoff)

Thanks Ben — I reviewed the MAP and SOW draft. High level alignment and proposed owners look good. A couple of clarifying asks before we lock the kickoff: 

1) Can we get the final expected monthly token volume by request type (search vs. summarize vs. embeddings)? This helps sizing for burst vs. reserved capacity.
2) For SOC 2 artifacts, I can share our compliance pack if Ben confirms permission to send to procurement@lumina.ai.

Proposed immediate next steps (for clarity):
- Internal: Soojin to prepare 30/60/90 day rollout milestones and initial playbook.
- Internal: Vivek to validate 32k token path on a staging job and report by 2028-03-30.
- External: Ben to schedule 60-min kickoff w/ Lumina for 2028-04-04 09:00 PST.
- External: Ben to share SOW link + SOC 2 evidence with Jordan.

I will add internal notes in the shared Drive. If everyone is aligned, Soojin you will be the primary for customer health and post-signing deliverables.

Priya Natarajan
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>; Alex Morton <alex.morton@lumina.ai>; Jordan Rivera <j.rivera@lumina.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumina AI - mutual action plan, next 60 days (handoff)

Thanks — I accept the lead. Initial notes from my side: 
- I'll partition the rollout into three zones: sandbox onboarding (week 0-2), pilot validation (week 3-6), production ramp (week 7-12).
- Need the following access up front: a staging API token, example document corpus (anonymized), and a schema for expected search queries. Can Ben or Alex drop those into the Drive?
- I'll prep a short kickoff agenda and a customer success plan doc for the kickoff.

Preliminary risks to flag: potential latency issues for 1000+ concurrent searches — will need to evaluate batching and model routing. Also want to confirm whether Lumina plans to enable KV cache reuse across sessions (policy question).

Soojin Lee
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>; Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Mar 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumina AI - mutual action plan, next 60 days (handoff)

Quick technical validation note: I ran a staged 32k token inference path against a 13B variant on a test VM yesterday. Results: 1) memory footprint is within expected for our quantized builds, 2) tail latency spikes at ~2.5% under heavy batching. I will run a dedicated throughput test and share a short report by 2028-03-30. Also can confirm we can integrate Lumina's KMS with our customer-scoped key wrapping — need procurement/legal to sign the KMS appendix (see SOW).

Vivek
Principal Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference

Priya will be primary escalation for SLA questions. Vivek will be on the technical deep-dive. Tessa to run resource roster and add the 90-day staffing plan to the Drive.

Action items now: 
- Ben: Share final SOW link + SOC 2 packet to procurement@lumina.ai (today).
- Soojin: Upload kickoff agenda and short playbook to Drive (by EOD 2028-04-03).
- Vivek: Post throughput validation report to Drive (by 2028-03-30 - posted).

Looking forward to a smooth transition — happy to join the kickoff to introduce the team.

Ben Carter
